accepted_seed_failure.reason: Only the overstrict remote zero-write assertion failed; all three completed minimal builds passed output/cache checks.

method: Reuse original Datadog worktree/output/scratch paths. Verify steady frozen local seed and catalog, then independently copy immutable metadata/CAS and catalog. Fresh JVM and synchronous clean before every build; empty graph/outputs/action cache checked. Same remote action cache/BES; no disk cache. New binary for local and remote. Identical frozen local seed and remote catalog. Fresh staging cache each run. Remote backend restart and one full read/idempotent-commit warmup excluded from timers; new commit writes not warmed. Exactly one toplevel sample per arm, no stabilization or repetitions. Local writes must be zero; remote uncached cache-only writes are recorded, not capped. Metadata proxy counts gRPC wire bytes, separate from action-cache gRPC logs.
